Dialogue.Text: What a lengthy day it was...

That was quite a discussion we had with the head of the Digital Media Lab,^2 but we managed to talk things through.^1 Apparently,^2 the Supervisor infiltrated *their* ranks from the *Robotic Takeover Movement*.
Glad that all is over.^1 Wouldn't you agree,^2 Robot?
DO NOT THINK US AS FRIENDS.^1 I AM JUST HERE TO DISPOSE OF THE WASTE.
Hmm,^2 on that note,^2 I have a question.^1 You do like to cook,^2 right?
IT'S ONE OF THE JOYS OF LIFE,^2 YES.
Well, I had a chat with *"Lord"*.^1 Maybe there's still some hope left for us.
I've been understanding a lot of the things you said during our deductions.
I can help translate the recipes for you.^1 Then,^2 you wouldn't have as much trouble.
Like,^2 for instance,^2 long thingy things,^2 right?^1 Those are just sticks for the Popsicles.
And the yum yum sauce?^1 Bolognese!^1 Yum yum,^2 indeed.
FINE,^2 I WILL KEEP COOKING FOR *THE ORANGE KITTEN* UNDER THOSE TERMS AND CONDITIONS.
